liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Jack Straw** (1 review): The transition from Sugaree into this song prompted the reviewer to download the show [13]
- **Fire On The Mountain** (1 review): Oteil sang the lead vocal on this song [10]

## Setlist highlights

- **Samson & Delilah**: back after 54 archived shows (490 days) [15]
- **High Time**: rare: 13 archived performances [15]
- **PA outage**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [15]
- **PA outage**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [15]

## The recordings

- **deadandcompany2019-06-23.neumann_skm150.sunboy.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 21 songs; 187 min; rated 4.67/5 by 3 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls this a beautiful, stellar-sounding recording; Reviewer heard three recordings of this show and finds this one sounds best: clean and clear [11][12]
- **deadco2019-06-23.NakamichiCM700s**: audience recording; 18 songs; 184 min [2]
- **DeadCo2019-06-23.travitz.schoepsCMC64v.flac16**: source not stated; 18 songs; 185 min; rated 4/5 by 8 [3]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the recording's quality good; Reviewer describes the sound of the recording as haunting [6][14]

## Around the show

- Taper seated in section 112, marked 'Taper' on the ticket, was confronted by three security guards trying to remove him; nearby fans helped him [7]
- John Mayer played the Wolf guitar and Oteil sang Fire On The Mountain [10]
- John Mayer played Wolf, the Garcia guitar, at this show [14]
- Mayer played Garcia's Doug Irwin custom Wolf guitar for the entire show [1]
- Mayer played Jerry Garcia's Wolf guitar during the show [3]
- The PA crashed at the end of Fire on the Mountain and again during Drums [3]
- Reviewer felt the band seemed to have spent their energy at the Foxboro show the night before, though this one is tight [6]
- Reviewer attended the SPAC show and says it was great, but missed this New York show [8]
- Reviewer went to Foxboro, where taping was not allowed, unlike this show which was taped [9]
- Of three circulating recordings, this one sounded best to the reviewer [12]

## Tapers and lineage

- **deadandcompany2019-06-23.neumann_skm150.sunboy.flac16**: taped by Steven Weld; transferred by Steven Weld; source: Neumann SKM150(AK50's/LC3's/KM100's)>GAKables xlr>Lunatec V2>GAKables xlr>Apogee Mini-Me@24/96>AES/EBU>Sound Devices 722 @24bit/96kHz [1]. Also: Taped in the GA field, 10 feet right of center, in front of the board, 75 feet from stage [1]
- **deadco2019-06-23.NakamichiCM700s**: taped by Jon Pasternak & Joel Werner; source: AUD [2]. Also: Recorded by Jon Pasternak and Joel Werner using front-of-board Nakamichi CM 700s into an SD744, then Edirol R-09 [2]
- **DeadCo2019-06-23.travitz.schoepsCMC64v.flac16**: taped by Jeff Travitz; transferred by Keith Litzenberger; source: Schoeps CMC64v's>VMS5u>SD744t [3]. Also: Taper's KS5 IU cable crackled throughout the show during recording; Schoeps CMC64V mics and VMS5u into Sound Devices 744t, recorded from the front-of-board GA pit [3][7]

## Art and photos

- Poster by original-concert-posters.com: [Dead And Company Concert Poster 2019 Citi Field NY Signed By Artist Mike DuBois | Original Concert Posters](https://original-concert-posters.com/2021/06/16/dead-and-company-concert-poster-2019-citi-field-ny-signed-by-artist-mike-dubois/) [16]
